description: Marco Pau and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The publication describes a concrete software instantiation of an architecture for building-data sharing and analysis. Companion releases establish implemented processing, reasoning, aggregation, learning, optimisation and simulation services, including an AI service library. Early deployments and analytics releases have limited pilot coverage, so the record does not imply that all eleven planned pilots received every final service. The architecture uses open-source technologies, but that alone does not establish public source access or one licence covering all MATRYCS components. Current hosted availability and component-specific code terms remain unknown. This platform supports the separately documented building-energy models and applications. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
